EN: What do you want? It's the wasteland.
ZH: 你要什么？这可是废土。

EN: Nah. Go find another job if you want.
ZH: 那就去别处找工作吧。

EN: Bleehh… b… bed! Smell! NICE!
ZH: 嗯……床！ 香！好！

EN: Want… MATE… Aaaagh!
ZH: 想……伴侣……啊啊啊！

EN: Nnnnaaaahh!
ZH: 噶啊！

EN: Brrrroooooke!
You want A mate? Fine, just get out!
ZH: 你想要一个伴侣？好，先出去！

EN: You want TO mate?! Fine, just pay up!
ZH: 你想在这里找对象？！好，先交钱！

EN: Deathclaw Dee-Lite
ZH: 死爪迪莱特

EN: Deal!
ZH: 成交！

EN: You want to play it rough? Then let's go!
ZH: 你们想硬碰硬吗？那来吧！

EN: Alright, alright! Don't shoot!
ZH: 好吧，好吧！别开枪就行！

EN: Here, these are all the Caps I've got.
ZH: 给你们，这些是我全部的瓶盖。

EN: They're yours if you let me go!
ZH: 如果你们放了我的话，这些都是你们的！

EN: Hand over those Caps, and you can walk out of here.
ZH: 把这些瓶盖交过来，我们就让你活着走出去。

EN: No deal. You're going to pay for what you did.
ZH: 不行。你要为你的行为付出代价。

EN: Red Rachel is a ruthless Raider boss, and she's stolen some of your supplies. Take back what's yours, and teach that reckless rogue a lesson!
ZH: 红瑞秋是一个凶残的掠夺者首领。她偷走了一些你们的物资。拿回本属于你的东西，然后给这些莽夫们一点颜色看看！

EN: Den of Thieves
ZH: 深入丹恩城

EN: Reclaim the lost supplies.
ZH: 追回丢失的物资。

EN: Confront the Raider Boss.
ZH: 对抗掠夺者首领。

EN: Reclaim the stolen supplies from the Raiders.
ZH: 追回被掠夺者窃取的物资。

EN: Detective Case Files
ZH: 侦探的案件档案

EN: Oh well. I tried to warn you...
ZH: 哦。我试图警告你……

EN: Have this as a token of our appreciation.
ZH: 以此表达我们的感谢。

EN: Well, I guess you can have that. We don't really need it.
ZH: 这个，我想你可以拿着。我们真的不需要它。

EN: Hold it right there, Dweller.
ZH: 站住，避难所居民。

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel is requisitioning any tech found in this location.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会正在回收在这个位置发现的任何技术。

EN: For your own safety, please evacuate this area.
ZH: 为了您自身的安全，请撤离本区。

EN: No, I think I'll just stay and take what I want.
ZH: 不，我想我会留下来带走我想要的。

EN: All right, I'll just show myself out, then.
ZH: 好吧，我这就自己出去。

EN: Come on, can't you guys share anything here?
ZH: 拜托，你们不能在这里分享什么吗？

EN: One of your Dwellers found an abandoned Red Rocket truck stop! Maybe there's some valuable junk inside...
ZH: 你的一个居民发现了一辆废弃的红色火箭卡车站！也许里面有一些有价值的垃圾……

EN: Dibs at the Red Rocket
ZH: 谁先到红火箭

EN: Look for valuable junk.
ZH: 寻找有价值的垃圾。

EN: Look through Red Rocket for useful junk.
ZH: 搜寻红火箭寻找有用的垃圾。

EN: Very well. Here's what we have!
ZH: 非常好。这是我们有的东西！

EN: I think we can spare a few implements of destruction.
ZH: 我们可以给你们一些搞破坏的道具。

EN: I think we have something right up your alley!
ZH: 我们有一些东西，可能正合你们口味！

EN: It's the diplomats from the Vault!
ZH: 是来自避难所的外交家！

EN: We have a gift for you, but our settlement can only send you back with one thing.
ZH: 我们有一个礼物要送给你们。但你们只能选一样。

EN: What would you like?
ZH: 你们想要哪种？

EN: Caps. Precious, precious bottlecaps.
ZH: 瓶盖。宝贝又珍贵的瓶盖。

EN: We'll take whatever weapons you have.
ZH: 你们有什么武器的话就给我们吧。

EN: Our Vault has great fashion sense. We want more outfits.
ZH: 我们是个讲时尚的避难所。我们想要更多的衣服。

EN: A local settlement wants to make contact with our Vault! We should send some diplomats.
ZH: 一个当地的定居点试图联系我们避难所！我们应该派一些外交家去。

EN: Diplomatic Mission!
ZH: 外交任务！

EN: Talk to the settlers.
ZH: 和定居者交谈。

EN: Send a team in Formal Wear out to talk to a settlement.
ZH: 派遣一队着装正式的居民去和定居点的代表交谈。

EN: That's *point* 22. Here, let me show you.
ZH: 那是“点22”（.22口径）。且听我说。

EN: ...or very small values of 5. All right, you can go through.
ZH: ……对取极小值的5也算。好吧，你可以过去了。

EN: Okay, maybe that was a little *too* simple...
ZH: 好吧，也许那有点太简单了……

EN: Hold it right there, mouthbreathers!
ZH: 等等，你们这些用嘴呼吸的家伙！

EN: In order to continue, you must prove your math skills.
ZH: 为了继续下去，你必须先证明你们的数学技能。

EN: Since you guys don't look too smart, we'll start with a simple one.
ZH: 既然你们看起来不太聪明，我们就从简单的开始。

EN: Does 2 + 2 equal 5?
No, 2 + 2 is 22, like the caliber.
Only for very large values of 2.
ZH: 这只对取极大值的2成立。

EN: Two and two are four.
ZH: 二加二等于四。

EN: Wrong, the two are considered to be of equal value! Kill them!
ZH: 错了，这两个被认为是同等价值的！杀了他们！

EN: Indeed, it is! Here's your reward.
ZH: 的确，它是！这是你的奖励。

EN: I think I'll make a scatter plot... of your brains!
ZH: 我想我会做一个散点分析……关于你的大脑的！

EN: You guys got here just in time to help settle an argument.
ZH: 你们来得正好，到这里来帮助解决一场争论。

EN: Can you tell us if 1 is the same as 0.999...?
ZH: 你能告诉我们1和0.999是一样的吗？

EN: That's 0.9 with an infinitely repeating decimal.
ZH: 这是一个无限重复小数点0.9。

EN: No, 1 is larger than 0.999...
Yes, 1 is equal to 0.999...
Here, check out my infinitely repeating firearm.
ZH: 来，见识见识我这把无限连发枪吧。

EN: Normally I'd agree with you, but I'm feeling negative today.
ZH: 通常我同意你的意见，但今天我并不想。

EN: Maybe this was true once, but that's no longer the case.
ZH: 也许曾经如此，但如今已不是这样了。

EN: I can't add anything to this, you won fair and square.
ZH: 我不能添加任何东西，你赢得光明正大。

EN: That sounds rational.
ZH: 听起来有道理。

EN: So, you've managed to get this far...impressive!
ZH: 所以，你居然答对了这么多……真让人印象深刻！

EN: We'll move to another quadrant if you can answer this simple test.
ZH: 如果你能回答这个简单的测试，我们就移到另一个象限。

EN: Be warned: 90% of those who tried to solve this got it wrong!
ZH: 警告：90%回答这个问题的人都会搞错！

EN: What is 6÷2(1+2)?
6÷2(1+2) = 9. Final answer.
Easy: 6÷2(1+2) equals 1.
The equation is ambiguous, and meant to trick people.
ZH: 方程是模棱两可的，存在就是为了骗人的。

EN: Let me count out the answer with gunshots.
ZH: 让我用枪声来算出答案。

EN: There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, we need to send our smartest Dwellers to reduce the threat these radicals pose, and solve this acute situation.
ZH: 有一个新的掠夺者帮派，欧拉的天使，在废土为非作歹！闲话少说，我们得派最聪明的居民去化解这些激进分子的威胁，解决当前的危急局面。

EN: Divide and Conquer
ZH: 分而治之

EN: Defeat the Raider Boss.
ZH: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
ZH: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
ZH: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Euler's Angels.
ZH: 击败欧拉天使。

EN: This is the square root of all evil.
ZH: 这是万恶的平方根。

EN: “Go forth and multiply,” they said...
ZH: “出去然后做乘法吧，”他们说……

EN: That's not what we meant!
ZH: 我们不是那个意思！

EN: You from that Vault? You bring the things we wanted?
ZH: 来自避难所？带了我们想要的东西了吗？

EN: Well, we forgot the Caps and snacks... but here are the guns!
ZH: 好吧，我们忘了瓶盖和吃的了……但是我们有枪！

EN: We'll find out what you have when we kill ya!
ZH: 等我们杀了你们，就自然知道你们都有啥了！

EN: Well darn. I really wanted the snacks!
ZH: 该死。我真的很想吃东西！

EN: Huh, then we could write better ransom notes! You got a deal!
ZH: 呃，那我们就能写出更好的勒索信了！成交！

EN: It isn't? Well, shoot. I guess you can just have him, then. He's been eating too much food anyway.
ZH: 它不是吗？好吧，真烦。我想你们可以带走它了。它也太能吃了。

EN: You must be the dog's owner!
ZH: 你们一定是那只狗的主人！

EN: Fork over the guns, Caps, and snacks!
ZH: 交出你们的枪，瓶盖和吃的！

EN: I wouldn't want to shoot you in front of the dog. It's sensitive.
ZH: 我可不想在这狗面前杀你。它挺敏感的。

EN: We don't have any of those things, moron. Now hand over the dog!
ZH: 白痴，你说的这些东西我们都没有。现在赶紧把狗交出来！

EN: I've got your guns right here!
ZH: 你们的枪就在我这儿！

EN: We bring something better: the gift of knowledge. Give us the dog, and we'll teach you to write.
ZH: 我们带来了更好的礼物——知识。把狗交出来，我们会教你怎么写字。

EN: You're gravely mistaken. That isn't even our dog.
ZH: 恐怕你大错特错了。它甚至都不是我们的狗。

EN: A hastily written and grammatically incorrect note was left outside the Vault door: “IF U EVAR WANT TOO SEE YOU'RE DOG AGAN, COME TWO ARE BIG BILDING AND BRING GUNZ, CAPS, AND SNAX.” It must've been written by some really stupid Raiders, because we don't even have a missing dog. But if those jerks really do have a kidnapped canine, it still needs rescuing!
ZH: 避难所门口发现一张字迹潦草且满篇错字的字条。“如果泥门还想再见到那支狗，就来吾萌的房子，记住必许带上枪，瓶改和次的。”一定是那些愚蠢的掠夺者写的，因为我们根本就没有什么走失的狗。但是如果这些混蛋真的绑架了一个小家伙，我们还是要去救它。

EN: Dog Gone
ZH: 丢失的小狗

EN: Teach the Raiders a lesson and rescue the missing dog.
ZH: 拯救丢失的小狗，给掠夺者一个教训。

EN: Save a kidnapped pooch from a band of Raiders.
ZH: 从一帮掠夺者手里拯救被绑架的小狗。

EN: Hah! Over our dead bodies.
ZH: 哈！从我的尸体上踩过去。

EN: I keep telling them to be gentle.
ZH: 我一直和他们讲要温柔点。

EN: They would never eat my gift.
ZH: 他们绝对不会吃掉我的礼物。

EN: My Ghouls are lonely, so I got them a pet.
ZH: 我的尸鬼们很寂寞，所以我送了一只宠物给他们。

EN: We're here to rescue Fido!
ZH: 我们到这里来是为了救菲多！

EN: Can a Ghoul even take care of a pet?
ZH: 尸鬼能照顾好一只宠物吗？

EN: You mean you got them lunch.
ZH: 你的意思是你送给他们一顿午餐。

EN: Someone let Fido out without a leash. Guess you'll need to get him back.
ZH: 有人没给菲多栓链子就让它跑了出来。你们应该把它找回来。

EN: Dog Shelter
ZH: 狗狗避难所

EN: Rescue Fido.
ZH: 拯救菲多。

EN: Rescue Fido from the Ghouls.
ZH: 从尸鬼的手中拯救菲多。

EN: Looks like we need to correct your behavior!
ZH: 看来我们需要纠正你的行为！

EN: The Brotherhood sent you, didn't they? The mutt's ours! They can't have him!
ZH: 是兄弟会派你来的吧？那条杂种是我们的！和他们无关！

EN: I think we'll stick around. You don't look like you'd make the best pet owners.
ZH: 我想我们会留下来。你们看起来不像合格的宠物主人。

EN: No need for that. We can help you look for... what was it, a dog?
ZH: 没必要这样。我们可以帮你找……是什么来着，一条狗？

EN: Come on, we gotta find that dog, Wilzig might not be enough!
ZH: 来吧，我们得找到那条狗，威尔齐格可能不够！

EN: What? what are you looking at? Get out of here or there'll be trouble!
ZH: 什么？看什么看？快滚，不然有你好受的！

EN: You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from inside. What could it be? You won't know until you find out!
ZH: 你在返回菲利镇的路上经过一个破旧的加油站，听到里面传来的奇怪声音。那会是什么呢？只有进去才能知道！

EN: Codename: DOG
ZH: 代号：狗狗

EN: Find a new friend...
ZH: 找到新朋友……

EN: Investigate strange sounds at the Red Rocket.
ZH: 调查红火箭加油站的奇怪声音。

EN: There's a working radio here and it sounds like Three Dog's on the air.
ZH: 这里有一台打开的收音机，听起来像三狗正在直播。

EN: “Hello chilllldddreeenn! Join the Warshippers and serve War, the mightiest Horseman!”
ZH: “你们好啊，孩诶诶诶诶子滋滋滋滋滋滋们嗯嗯嗯嗯！加入“战争崇拜者”，为“战争”效忠吧，他是最伟大的‘骑士’！”

EN: What?! These Warshippers must be forcing him to spread propaganda.
ZH: 什么？！一定是这些“战争崇拜者”们强迫他这么做宣传的。

EN: We need to save him!
ZH: 我们需要拯救他！

EN: With those cute little blue suits of yours that are *so* intimidating, right?
ZH: 穿着你们那些可爱的蓝色小套装真是太吓人了，对吧？

EN: Oh no! The Pests have come to take our outfits! I'm shaking in my boots. Not.
ZH: 哦不！“害虫”来抢我们的装备了！我在颤抖。不。

EN: You certainly don't look very hungry. Those Ghouls must be fattening you up for later.
ZH: 你看起来可一点都不饿。那些尸鬼一定是在把你养肥，留着以后吃呢。

EN: Death finally makes a move and decides to send *you*? That's rather anticlimactic.
ZH: 死亡总算行动了，结果派来的是*你们*？还真是虎头蛇尾。

EN: Looky here, someone got through all the rookies. What, you think you can take us?
ZH: 看这里，有人打败了那些菜鸟。怎么，你们觉得能打败我们？

EN: No matter. The message is out. “You can't stop the signal,” after all.
ZH: 不管了。消息已发出。毕竟“你不能阻止信号传播”。

EN: Raiders will come from all over to serve War. Or else face his wrath. And his morning breath.
ZH: 掠夺者会从四面八方赶来为“战争”效力，否则就要面对他的怒火。还有他的晨间口臭。

EN: Now, before we introduce you to our weapons, tell me. Which Horseman sent you?
ZH: 现在，在亮出我的武器之前，告诉我。哪位“骑士”派你来的？

EN: None of them. We're Vault Dwellers and we'll stop the Horsemen.
ZH: 没谁。我们是避难所的居民，我们会阻止“骑士”。

EN: Pestilence. Blessed be the irradiated!
ZH: “瘟疫”。辐射保佑着我们！

EN: Famine. Let our hunger consume you!
ZH: “饥荒”。让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Death. But we haven't picked a slogan yet.
ZH: “死亡”。但我们还没有想好口号。

EN: Nope. But the Pests are greedy for protective gear. You could use some to lure them into a trap...
ZH: 不。但“害虫”们正觊觎着这些美好的装备。你可以用一些来引诱他们进入陷阱……

EN: You kids sure know how to fight the good fight! Doggone heroes is what ya are. Thanks!
ZH: 你们这些孩子一定知道如何打好仗！你们就是那些该死的英雄。谢谢！

EN: Come to me for info? Well a war of cults is brewin' out there, with Settlers caught in the crossfire.
ZH: 来向我打听情报？外面正在酝酿一场邪教间的战争，定居者被夹在交火之中。

EN: War, Famine and Pestilence, whoever they are, are all vying for power.
ZH: “战争”，“饥荒”和“瘟疫”，无论他们是谁，都在争夺权力。

EN: But Death is a no-show. Just rumors in the nuclear wind for now.
ZH: 但“死亡”没有出现。只是有些传闻。

EN: Do you know where we can find any of the Horsemen's cults?
ZH: 你知道我们在哪里可以找到任何和“骑士”有关的邪教吗？

EN: Famine and Pestilence are out there, whoever they are, with followers to spare. War and Death are the other infamous Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Are they terrorizing the Wasteland as well? If anyone knows, it's Three Dog at Galaxy News Radio. Let's go talk to him.
ZH: “饥荒”和“瘟疫”就在那里，无论他们是谁，追随者都大有人在。“战争”和“死亡”是臭名昭著的“末日骑士”。他们在废土肆虐吗？如果有人知道，一定是银河新闻电台的三狗。我们去跟他谈谈。

EN: Dogs of War
ZH: 战争之犬

EN: Talk to Three Dog.
ZH: 和三狗交谈。

EN: Listen to Three Dog's broadcast.
ZH: 听三狗的广播。

EN: Kill the Warshippers.
ZH: 消灭“战争崇拜者”。

EN: Talk to Three Dog about the Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
ZH: 与三狗谈论末日骑士。

EN: Make war, not love!
ZH: 制造战争，而不是爱！

EN: All hail War!
ZH: 战争万岁！

EN: Rest in war!
ZH: 安息在战争中！

EN: There it is! The... Wait... no. That's a ripped football uniform.
ZH: 找到了！是……等等……不对。是一件扯烂的足球服。

EN: Getting closer though, right?!
ZH: 但还是越来越近了，对吧？

EN: If I were a conniving Coach, where would I be? Maybe in the gym of Harriet Tubman High School? It's worth a shot...
ZH: 如果我是那个狡猾的教练，我会去哪儿呢？也许会去哈丽特塔布曼高中的体育馆吧？那地方值得一试……

EN: Do it for the Bat Boy!
ZH: 为了蝙蝠男孩！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Well, lookee here!
ZH: 好，看这里！

EN: Seems like we have ourselves some ginger-lovers!
ZH: 看起来我们有一些红发爱好者！

EN: No mercy!
ZH: 毫不留情！

EN: I don't think it's supposed to be literal...
ZH: 我不认为这应该是字面……

EN: Pfft. Thinking is for chumps, and losers, and gingers!
ZH: 呵呵。思考是为笨蛋，失败者，红发人准备的！

EN: Them's fightin' words! Attack!
ZH: 他们这是找打！攻击！

EN: Did you know gingers have no souls?
ZH: 你们知道，红法人没有灵魂吗？

EN: Better dead than a redhead!
ZH: 有红头发的话，还不如去死。

EN: Don't you agree, Dwellers?
ZH: 居民们，你们不觉得是这样吗？

EN: I think you're about to get your wish.
ZH: 我想你们会实现愿望的。

EN: Is that really what you think, boyo?
ZH: 你们真的是那么想的吗？

EN: I guess we'll have to agree to disagree.
ZH: 看来我们只能求同存异了。

EN: A bonnie lass once broke me heart, and I couldn't deal with it.
ZH: 美丽的姑娘曾经伤了我的心，可我不知道该怎么办。

EN: That's exactly what a ginger lover would say!
ZH: 这正是一个红发爱好者会说的话！

EN: Ireland's lack of snakes goes back to the last ice age!
ZH: 爱尔兰无蛇的历史可以追溯到上一个冰河时代！

EN: Hello there, Dwellers.
ZH: 你们好呀，避难所居民们。

EN: Come to join our fight against the *real* red menace?
ZH: 来加入我们对抗真正的红色威胁吗？
